legal.written_permission: Utah requires WRITTEN permission to hunt private land that is cultivated or properly posted. The permission must carry four things: the owner's signature, the name of the person given permission, the applicable dates, and a general description of the property. A verbal yes does not satisfy the statute.
legal.cultivated: Soil broken for crops, land used for crops, or artificially irrigated pasture - which covers most ag ground worth hunting.
legal.posted: 'No Trespassing' signs, or at least 100 square inches of bright yellow, bright orange or fluorescent paint, at all corners, at stream crossings, and on roads, gates and rights-of-way.
legal.penalty: Class B misdemeanor. Taking wildlife while trespassing is a separate offense and can suspend your license privileges.
